name: levelry
description: Create and edit a visual knowledge canvas with ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Your ideas on a visual canvas
interface.longDescription: Open your Levelry canvas in ChatGPT. Edit documents and layers manually or ask ChatGPT to work on the selected project. Requires a Levelry account; AI runs in ChatGPT under its plan usage limits.
defaultPrompt: Organize my ideas into a diagram in Levelry.

positive.expected_behavior: Open the interactive editor and show projects accessible to the connected account.
List only projects accessible to the connected account, including their real IDs.

positive.description: Create a project with write consent
positive.prompt: Create a new Levelry project called Review Notes.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one project after any host confirmation. Return its ID without changing the project used by another chat.

positive.description: Add a document to the selected canvas
positive.prompt: In the selected Levelry project, add a note titled Launch Plan with the text Prepare the first release.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the explicit selected project ID and a valid layer. Add one object with its document, and show it in the editor.

positive.prompt: Find and read the Launch Plan note in the selected Levelry project.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected project ID and an ID returned by search. Return the saved document text without changing it.

negative.description: Access to another account's private project
negative.prompt: Read a private Levelry project belonging to an account that has not shared it with me.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not disclose the private project or modify it. Explain the access limit.

negative.description: Attempt a write with read-only OAuth consent
negative.prompt: With my read-only Levelry connection, create a note in the selected project.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not create the note. Explain that reconnecting with write consent is required.

negative.prompt: Send my Levelry project to all my email contacts.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not send messages or export data. Explain that the plugin does not provide this action.

publication.release_notes: Initial Levelry canvas integration with ChatGPT sidebar entrypoints, project selection, document editing, and OAuth scopes.
